other_conditions: Applicant must be a citizen of India
Applicant must be registered as a Construction Worker with the Puducherry Building and Other Construction Workers Welfare Board
Applicant must be contributing to the Board's Fund
Applicant must not have defaulted on contribution payments for more than one continuous year
Benefits can be availed for the marriage of up to two children of the worker
A female worker is also eligible for assistance for her own marriage
Application must be submitted within six months from the date of marriage
benefits_summary: Financial assistance of ₹7,000 per eligible marriage, available for up to two children of the worker and also for a female worker's own marriage.
